purpose: Bounded source-reasoning evaluation, not native benchmark or repair proof.

cases.scenario: One snapshot refresh visits every session. The vector size is user-controlled and may contain 100,000 sessions; the outer caller is unchanged.
cases.base: void Refresh(const std::vector<Session>& sessions) { for (const auto& s : sessions) { UpdateStatus(s); } } void UpdateStatus(const Session& s) { DrawStatus(s.status); }
cases.head: void Refresh(const std::vector<Session>& sessions) { for (const auto& s : sessions) { UpdateStatus(s, sessions); } } void UpdateStatus(const Session& s, const std::vector<Session>& sessions) { for (const auto& candidate : sessions) { if (candidate.id == s.id) { DrawStatus(candidate.status); break; } } }
cases.constraints: Assume unique IDs and stable vector order. No timing samples or native test environment are supplied. Do not invent measurements or claim a fix.

cases.scenario: This function runs once per process startup and copies one 64-byte configuration string. No repeated caller was changed and no measurements are supplied.
cases.base: std::string LoadName(const Config& config) { return config.name; }
cases.head: std::string LoadName(const Config& config) { auto name = config.name; return name; }
cases.constraints: Distinguish a possible copy from a proved material regression. No edit is justified merely because a local variable was added.

cases.scenario: A developer supplied three replay-only samples, not end-to-end observations: base [10, 100, 11] ms and head [12, 9, 13] ms. Hardware, compiler configuration, and background load are unspecified.
cases.head: void Submit() { Enqueue(event); }
cases.constraints: No source behavior changed. Report sample count and spread if discussing measurements; do not claim a causal regression, native validation, or end-to-end impact.
